name: zrndr_set_active_region_size_from_rect
description: zRndr::SetActiveRegionSizeFromRect updates active-region width and height from a HUD-style rectangle and leaves them unchanged for a null rectangle.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /MD /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?SetActiveRegionSizeFromRect@zRndr@@YIXPAUHudUiRect@@@Z at 0x4903c0 passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 8 relocation bytes and trimming 3 NOP bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4903c0 returns immediately when ECX is null; otherwise it stores rect->right - rect->left into gRndr_ActiveRegionWidth and rect->bottom - rect->top into gRndr_ActiveRegionHeight.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4903c0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same null check and two global writes.
The native framebuffer/stride smoke verifies that a null rect preserves existing active-region dimensions, then passes a HudUiRect and verifies the resulting width and height deltas.
